title: OL-20261115-13: workers#183 GAP-LOOP-GITHUB: live cycle through the GitHub App
body:
**Owner:** ROWAN (identity-bound: GitHub App install)
**Trigger:** App installed
**Done check:** grep:docs/PROJECT-MEMORY.md::codeloop live cycle verified
**Status:** open

Moved from ultrastable/workers#183. Code merged in workers#190: opt-in codeloop_merge tick step, merges a runner PR only under the trust ladder. Remaining: install the GitHub App on the repo (NEEDS-YOU lane-credential, https://ultrastable.io/connect/github) and run one live cycle that opens an issue and a PR and merges it. A fresh ledger starts below autonomous, so first live merges are refused by design until the rung or merge_min_rung is set.
